Game Overview

In Mew Cat, the core idea is straightforward: join a daring cat in Mew Cat’s delightful 2D platformer adventure. Navigate through perilous spikes, enemy felines, and treacherous saws while mastering precise movements and the essential double jump. Collect bowls of cat food across eight exhilarating levels as the charming quest intensifies with each step forward.
